propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) lack multi-page test coverage despite using opaque cursor pagination with nextPageToken
The cursor loop terminates on two independent conditions (isLast or absent/null nextPageToken) but existing tests only exercise single-page responses with isLast=True
A repeated cursor token can cause infinite request loops with fail-open exception handling, resulting in silently truncated maps
The same pagination defect class (advance-by-size, break-on-short-page) was fixed three times on DC but Cloud uses opaque cursors and pages correctly, so the test is regression-net not bug-fix
A structural AST guard over adapters/jira/*.py prevents unpaginated whole-project readers from being added silently by requiring loop and nextPageToken mention
